page.overview:
Who is Adnan?

Adnan is a Djinn, a genie who has existed since before human creation. He stopped his brother Marid from preventing World War I. In the present day, Adnan was banished to an unknown dimension by his brother so that Adnan wouldn't be able to interfere in Marid's plans to tamper with history.
